title: Flock Safety engages Bishop Fox to bolster cybersecurity for public safety platform
summary: Flock Safety announced it has engaged offensive-security firm Bishop Fox to conduct adversarial testing across its hardware and software products, framed as part of Flock's broader security governance (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, CJIS compliance).

key_quotes.quote: Bishop Fox's offensive security experts will engage in complex, multistage and multilayer adversarial testing across all of Flock's products, both hardware and software.

Flock's customers and the public at large should expect the most advanced cybersecurity program in the public safety industry, and that is why we are bringing on the most respected leader in offensive security, Bishop Fox
